target_claim: The map s_α ↦ α embeds S into the ordinal β defined as the union of the indices used by the construction.
source_quote: Now, we can impose a [[Definition:Well-Ordering|well-ordering]] on $S$ by embedding it via $s_\alpha \to \alpha$ into the ordinal $\beta = \ds {\bigcup_{s_\alpha \mathop \in S} \alpha}$ and using the [[Definition:Well-Ordering|well-ordering]] of $\beta$.
